unharnessed.meaning: Every feature and claim survives in order. "at a whopping scale" mildly overstates "at scale". "make sure nothing ever falls over" is a fair rendering of "no downtime".
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit the technical sense: "carks it", "cop a hit and keep going" (resilient), "turf the old ones", "knocks off containers that won't answer", "doesn't let on to clients they exist".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural Aussie tech chat: "Wouldn't it be a bloody sight easier", "whatever storage system takes your fancy", "without mucking about with the upstream source code".
unharnessed.register: A solid level 4 throughout, including the bullet list, with swearing at a dad-level "bloody".
unharnessed.tone: The explanatory, upbeat docs tone is kept as friendly chat.
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly, though "Kubernetes isn't your traditional, all-in, everything-in-the-box PaaS" stacks synonyms a little.
unharnessed.variety: Varied: carks it, fire up, cop a hit, no worries, slammed, takes your fancy, clip, turf, bang for your buck, stash, dishing out, mucking about.
unharnessed.essence: Unmistakably the Kubernetes overview, structure and anchors intact.

yarn.meaning: Every point survives. "A toolbox, not a flat-pack house, basically." and "like a good Tetris player" are colour hung off the original. "at a pace you control" for "at a controlled rate" is fine.
yarn.sense: Terms fit: "carks it", "bounce back when something breaks", "without breaking a sweat", "leaving your secrets lying about".
yarn.authenticity: Natural, though "Pull up a stool." is a stock yarn opener for a docs page.
yarn.register: Level 4 throughout, with no swearing (allowed but not needed).
yarn.flow: Smooth: "Kubernetes then packs the containers onto your nodes like a good Tetris player, so you get the most out of your resources."
yarn.variety: Varied: mob, carks it, fire up, without breaking a sweat, slammed, brand-spankin'-new, lying about, wiggle room.
yarn.essence: Clearly the Kubernetes overview, with a pithy closing summary.

engine.meaning: Content mostly verbatim, but "run containerized yakka" muddles "tasks", and the inserted exclamations add nothing true.
engine.sense: "containerized yakka" uses "yakka" (hard work) for a computing task, which is the wrong sense. "practices from the mob" is vague for "the community".
engine.authenticity: Stage-Australian tags bolted onto docs prose: "Crikey, Google open sourced", "Bloody hell, Kubernetes provides you with a framework", "this behaviour was handled by a system, mate?". The US spelling "containerized" is left in.
engine.register: Mostly untranslated docs with sprinkles of swearing, well below level 4. "bloody" stays within dad level, but it is used as filler.
engine.tone: Clear technical tone undercut by random exclamations: "Bloody hell, Kubernetes provides".
engine.flow: Jarring joins: "'s', ay. Crikey, Google", and "brand-spankin'-new" twice in one sentence.
engine.essence: Recognisably the docs, since it is mostly untouched, but cluttered.

yarn.why: A stock pub-yarn opener, bolted onto technical docs.

engine.original: Kubernetes provides you with a framework

engine.quote: adopt all their resources to the brand-spankin'-new container

summaries.unharnessed: A natural, accurate and consistently level-4 retelling of the docs.
summaries.yarn: Very close to A: natural and accurate, with a couple of stock touches.
summaries.engine: A mechanical pass: mostly untranslated docs with oaths and tags dropped in.
